dedupe_keys.name: fiberq fibre network design plugin for qgis ftth gpon fttx

description: FiberQ is a QGIS plugin that helps telecom engineers and GIS professionals design, analyse and document fibre-optic networks (FTTH, GPON and FTTx) inside QGIS. The repository page lists tags such as fiber, telecom, FTTH, PostGIS, GPON and network design, and reports that version 1.5.0 was released on 17 September 2026, supports QGIS 4 with Qt6 while keeping support for QGIS 3.22 LTR and later, and clears all findings from the QGIS repository security scan. Producer: developer Vladimir Vukovic, maintained under the account vukovicvl, with a project home page at fiberq.net and a public code repository. Coverage: generic; it works on any area for which the user has address and route data. Access: installation from the QGIS plugin repository, with a versions history and bug tracker. Licence and cost: the page calls it open source, and some advanced features may require an activation key, so it is recorded as freemium with the licence text still to be confirmed. Caveats: no functional documentation or validation study was read, and the advanced features behind the key are not described. Simulation uses: it supports capacity and route planning of access networks and the creation of network topology layers for resilience analysis. Related record: the Geospatial Network Inventory FTTH design tool (platform-gni-free-ftth-design).
